mapping.summary: Quality checks in purchasing and production
claims: Quality orders created at warehouse receipt for lot/expiry and non-lot items
Automatic triggering of inspection on receipt based on item configuration
Quality hold on received items until inspection passed
Records inspection results, remarks and attached reports
Auto movement of rejected goods to rejection area
Lot-wise quality orders on production output posting
Configurable checklists at production stages (start, in-process, end)
Sampling by quantity, item type or routing operation
Blocks production order progress until quality checks pass
Metric types: true/false rating, range, fixed value with tolerance
Reusable test templates across items or processes
Rejection rate analysis by vendor or per production batch
Optional Power BI dashboards for live monitoring
